The combined MIAO-GTNH questline (110 quests, two directions). Direction one — the era spine: a root quest and seven era gates spread along the X axis from Steam to LuV with zero cross-gate edges, so you may enter at any era; gate wings and pain-point quests hand you tools at each era's key bottlenecks. Direction two — the three-mod integration district: GTSR's steam-economy hub, GTSWN's wireless grid, and GTIT's neko economy and rings — three subtrees, none era-gated. Plus a LuV+ open line (bee genetics and endgame manifestos) and the graduation quest "The Master" — also the key to the vending machine's Endgame Exchange page (gate 5569054221778550784:110).
